lines.zh: 我拖着步子走，一只脚轻一只脚重。
lines.en: I shamble along, one foot light, one heavy.

lines.zh: 我的下颌一直张着，合不上。
lines.en: My jaw hangs open and will not close.
I cross the tiles with a dull sound.
I stop in the corridor and turn my head.

lines.zh: 我走一步，机件就响一声。
lines.en: Each step clicks once.
I go along with a hand on the wall.
I go around the debris on the floor.
My head stays tilted.

lines.zh: 我走得很慢，可我一直在靠近。
lines.en: I am slow, but I keep getting closer.

lines.zh: 我拖着那条腿穿过门框。
lines.en: I drag that leg through the doorway.
My fingers stay spread at my sides.

lines.zh: 我从舞台那边走到这边来。
lines.en: I come from the stage over to here.

lines.zh: 我站着，眼窝里的光忽明忽暗。
lines.en: I stand, the glow in my eye sockets flickering.

lines.zh: 我歪着头，好像在想什么。
lines.en: I tilt my head as if thinking.
There is a sound of paper inside my chest.

lines.zh: 我不动，只是偶尔抖一下。
lines.en: I stay still, twitching now and then.
My casing is torn in several places.

lines.zh: 我在听通风管里的声音。
lines.en: I am listening to the sound in the vents.

lines.zh: 我不知道自己站了多久。
lines.en: I do not know how long I have stood here.

lines.zh: 夜还长，我在这儿站一会儿。
lines.en: The night's long. I'll stand here a while.
I turn my head, very slowly.
You stand right there and do not shift.

lines.zh: 我的下颌歪着，收不回来。
lines.en: My jaw hangs crooked; I can't close it.
My mouth opens a little wider.
I raise a hand and point at you.
You have backed to the door.
I take one step forward.
Are you... staring at my beak?
My casing dents inward.
Something inside has snapped.

lines.zh: 外壳裂了，里面的电路还亮。
lines.en: The casing cracked and the circuits still glow.

lines.zh: 我抖了一下，纸屑掉出来。
lines.en: I shudder and paper scraps fall out.

lines.zh: 我的动作慢了半拍，下颌松了。
lines.en: My movement lags half a beat; my jaw is loose.
I make a very low sound.
I raise a hand and set my head straight.
Don't hit this old shell of mine.

lines.zh: 你举着这个，我看不出用处。
lines.en: You hold that up and I see no use in it.
There is only paper in my belly.
That is not for me.
My head tipped sideways.
You put it down on the floor.
It is you I want.
I cannot use this piece.

lines.zh: 我的下巴合不上，怎么吃。
lines.en: How would I eat with this jaw?
You keep these.

lines.zh: 你撞我，我的外壳凹了一块。
lines.en: You hit me and my casing dents.
I am barely moved.
My step only slips a little.
I square myself up again.
My hand grazes your arm.
That touch does not hurt.

lines.zh: 你退开的时候，我还在往前。
lines.en: When you pull back, I am still coming.
Do not bump me; it is all wires in here.
I keep walking with my head tilted.
I fill the doorway entire.
I have no such program.
I tilt my head and do not answer.
I turned away slowly.

lines.zh: 这间屋里没有别的玩偶。
lines.en: There is no other animatronic in this room.
I stand a long time without moving.
My jaw clicks.
I do not have that function.
I walk off toward the corridor.

lines.zh: 我弯腰把它拾起来端详。
lines.en: I bent and picked it up to look at it.

lines.zh: 这东西不像给小孩的玩具。
lines.en: This does not look like a child's toy.
I push it into my chest cavity.

lines.zh: 它从我的指缝掉下去了。
lines.en: It falls between my fingers.
I do not know this.

lines.zh: 我拿着它，不知道怎么办。
lines.en: I hold it and do not know what to do.
My fingers are too stiff.

lines.zh: 我一用力就把它捏碎了。
lines.en: I squeezed and it broke.
Threads are loose in my yellow cloth.

lines.zh: 你动了一下，我就看见了。
lines.en: You moved once, and I saw it.
My head snaps level.
I am coming toward you.
I have got hold of you.
My jaw opens wider.
I am not swaying now.
I am not fast now; I am just no longer slow.

lines.zh: 你进了这条走廊，就出不去了。
lines.en: You came into this corridor; you will not leave it.
I press in a step at a time.

lines.zh: 我眼窝里的光跳了一下。
lines.en: The light in my socket jumped.
There are only the two of us in here.
I have stepped back from the door.
There is no call for me to run.
My fingers are already spread.
I follow you and never lose a step.
However long the corridor, I will not stop.

lines.zh: 我的脚步声一直在你后面。
lines.en: My footsteps stay behind you.

lines.zh: 你把门关上了，我听得见。
lines.en: You shut a door; I heard it.
I feel my way along the wall.

lines.zh: 风管那边有声音，我知道你走哪。
lines.en: There is a sound in the vent; I know your path.
No need to look back; I am always here.
My figure blocks the light.
I press in step by step.

lines.zh: 我把你的退路一点点收窄。
lines.en: I narrow your way out, piece by piece.
Your breathing has gone ragged.

lines.zh: 我的外壳在灯下反着灰光。
lines.en: My casing throws a grey shine under the lamp.
I raise a hand and steady it on the wall.
I always know where you are.

lines.zh: 这里的每一条路我都走过。
lines.en: I have walked every route in here.
The last door is locked.
I am slow, but I do not stop.
You hear me behind you now.
I rake down, my nails very long.

lines.zh: 我的下颌咬合，声音很脆。
lines.en: My jaw snaps shut with a sharp clack.
I lunge with both hands.
That came down on your shoulder.

lines.zh: 两只手一起按住你的肩膀。
lines.en: Both hands pin your shoulders down.

lines.zh: 我的手指扣住你的手腕。
lines.en: My fingers clamp your wrist.
I did not pull back once.
The overhead light flickered.
My head is tilted, but my hands do not stop.

lines.zh: 我的下颌松了，一直挂着。
lines.en: My jaw has come loose and hangs there.
That one came down heavy.
My mouth is full of paper scraps.

lines.zh: 我的关节响着，又近了一步。
lines.en: My joints creak; another step closer.
My casing is creaking.
The other hand comes up.
My mouth has never closed.
No one else is coming.
I have you pinned.
This night has a long way to go.
In the dark, a gear begins to turn.
My head moves first.

lines.zh: 走廊尽头多了一个影子。
lines.en: A shape appears at the end of the corridor.
I straighten up against the door frame.

lines.zh: 地砖上有我的脚步声了。
lines.en: My footsteps are on the tiles now.
This room has someone in it again.
I come down out of the vent.
My casing scrapes the wall.
The lamp finds my face.
I tilt my head and look for a long time.

lines.zh: 火燎到我的布皮，我拍了两下。
lines.en: Fire catches my fabric skin; I swat at it twice.

lines.zh: 落地时我的腿发出咔的一声。
lines.en: On landing, my leg gives a crack.

lines.zh: 水灌进我的外壳，里面的东西短路了。
lines.en: Water floods my casing and something shorts out.

lines.zh: 我整个被掀翻，倒在地上。
lines.en: The blast flips me and I land on the floor.
Something lodges in my chest casing.

lines.zh: 一股力让我的关节僵住了。
lines.en: Some force seizes my joints.

lines.zh: 我没有饿的感觉，可我也在变慢。
lines.en: I do not feel hunger, yet I am slowing.

lines.zh: 雷打下来，我全身的机件都跳了一下。
lines.en: Lightning hits and every part of me jolts.

lines.zh: 脚下没有了地板，我抓不住任何东西。
lines.en: The floor is gone and I cannot grip anything.
